name: Strongholds
overview: Scripture reveals that God is our eternal refuge and protector, providing strength and deliverance against every enemy and adversity, as affirmed in Deuteronomy 33:27 and Isaiah 54:17. Believers are called to trust in Christ as the exclusive way to the Father (John 14:6) and to practice forgiveness, which opens the door to divine forgiveness (Matthew 6:14). Our hope and help come from the Lord alone, who upholds us with His everlasting arms (Psalms 121:1) and whose blessings we must continually remember and praise (Psalms 103:2).
